payload.title: Naive surface-target continuation
payload.statement: Unconditional constant, robust-linear, quadratic, or damped-spline continuation of visible-prefix U=TVT+Z will outperform last-known TVT.
payload.evidence_for: U=TVT+Z is substantially smoother than the wrong-sign transform and its visible/hidden slopes have strong oracle correlation.
payload.evidence_against: E002 scored 39.6546 for the best challenger versus 15.9099 baseline, with 0/25 fold-cell wins and worse tails in every hidden-length regime.
payload.next_test: Predict the small heel-to-toe U-slope delta and hidden TVT drift separately; evaluate risk detection separately from signed action.
